title: Belshazzar
lead: The Babylonian prince who gives the feast of Daniel 5 and is killed the night Babylon falls (Daniel 5:30). Babylonian texts name Bel-shar-usur as the eldest son of the last king, Nabonidus, who ran Babylon while his father was away in Arabia. The book of Daniel calls him king and son of Nebuchadnezzar, which historians debate.
